Plugin.name: Jellyfin Exporter
Plugin.description: Export movies, shows and seasons to a folder using FFmpeg profiles (codec, resolution, audio channels).
Plugin.overview: Pick movies, series or seasons in the dashboard, choose an export profile, and let Jellyfin's own FFmpeg write the files to a directory you control.

versions.changelog: Initial scaffold: plugin entry point, configuration page, shared export models and installable release packaging.
